anthropic.scope: User-supplied PDF only; no independent authenticity check or external data added.
anthropic.page_convention: pdf_page is 1-based physical PDF page; printed_page is the number printed within the filing.

facts.detail: Incorporated as a Delaware public benefit corporation in January 2021.

facts.narrative_es: En el primer trimestre de 2023 lanzó públicamente su primer producto comercial: Claude.
facts.detail: The cited passage establishes quarter, not a specific launch day.

facts.narrative_es: Ingresos anuales de 41 millones de dólares en 2023, 386 millones en 2024 y 4,585 millones en 2025.
facts.basis: GAAP revenue, years ended December 31; annual data derived from audited statements.

facts.narrative_es: Ingresó 16,286 millones de dólares en los primeros seis meses de 2026: aproximadamente 14 veces los 1,163 millones del mismo semestre de 2025.
facts.basis: Six months ended June 30 in both years; unaudited interim GAAP revenue. Not full-year revenue, ARR or run-rate.

facts.narrative_es: El gasto de cómputo e infraestructura fue de 8,945 millones de dólares en el primer semestre de 2026.
facts.basis: Operating expense; not cash paid or future commitments. Supports research, model development, customer workloads and internal use; not a pure cost-of-revenue measure.

facts.narrative_es: En el primer semestre de 2026 tuvo pérdida operativa de 693 millones de dólares, pero flujo de efectivo operativo positivo de 3,929 millones.
facts.basis: Net loss includes 72,388 million fair-value adjustment primarily driven by increased enterprise valuation, added back in cash-flow reconciliation. Do not depict 80,748 million net loss as cash spent. Operating cash flow depends also on timing and working capital; investing outflows include securities purchases, not only infrastructure.

facts.narrative_es: El documento describe unos 417 mil millones de dólares en pagos mínimos futuros de nuevos contratos y ampliaciones de cómputo e infraestructura posteriores a 2025.
facts.basis: Note 15 subsequent events: agreements subsequent to December 31, 2025, commencing 2026-2027 with terms from less than one year to 20 years. Not already-incurred expenditure, annual spending or GDP impact. Separately estimates 125-150 billion under expanded agreements with commercial terms not finalized; do not casually combine.

facts.narrative_es: El S-1 está fechado el 26 de octubre de 2026. El IPO sigue propuesto: precio y número de acciones en blanco; solicitud para cotizar en Nasdaq como ANT.
facts.basis: Preliminary prospectus; securities cannot be sold until effective registration. No verified listing date, offering price, final valuation or completed bell-ringing event. Company and selling stockholders both propose sales; Anthropic receives no proceeds from selling-stockholder sales.

comparison_rules: H1 2026 vs H1 2025 for year-over-year growth; full-year 2025 is a different period length.
Run-rate revenue annualizes trailing 28-day consumption fees x13 plus monthly subscription fees x12. It is neither GAAP revenue nor a forecast (PDF14/printed3; PDF78/printed67).

In CSP marketplace arrangements Anthropic is principal and recognizes revenue on a gross basis, with partner and compute costs separately expensed. Cross-company comparisons need compatible gross/net accounting (PDF367/printedF-21).
Revenue, operating result, net result, cash flow, valuation, funding and commitments must remain distinct.
Blank September/IPO amounts in this PDF cannot be filled by inference.
The bell-ringing scene must be labeled possible future chapter, not completed historical event.
anthropic.visual_validation: Rendered and visually inspected PDF33; table values and period headings confirmed.

methodology.subtitle_es: Contamos el año de constitución como año 1. Cada cifra corresponde a un ejercicio anual completo terminado el 31 de diciembre.
methodology.age_definition: Ordinal calendar year since incorporation, inclusive. Not exact elapsed age, anniversary year, years since first revenue or years since commercial launch.
methodology.basis: Nominal annual reported revenue; no inflation adjustment. No ARR, annualized run-rate, valuation or half-year data in this comparison.
methodology.display_rounding: Round historical company values to one decimal or whole USD millions, while retaining exact values in this file.
methodology.preferred_detail_es: La misma etapa aproximada, en épocas distintas. Año 1 es el de constitución; los ingresos son anuales y en dólares de cada época, sin ajustar por inflación.
methodology.limits_es: No es una clasificación de mejores empresas ni una predicción. Comercio, publicidad e IA tienen costos, márgenes y reglas de reconocimiento distintos. La comparación no iguala tiempo de operación, tamaño del mercado ni poder adquisitivo.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.model_context_es: Modelos y productos de IA. El PDF indica reconocimiento bruto en acuerdos con marketplaces de nube cuando Anthropic actúa como principal; costos de socios y cómputo se registran aparte.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.revenue_locator: Physical PDF page 4, Item 6 Selected Consolidated Financial Data, Net sales row; values in thousands converted to millions
companies.model_context_es: Comercio minorista: ventas de productos netas de devoluciones y descuentos, más cargos de envío. Net sales significa ventas netas, no ganancia neta. La tienda abrió en julio de 1995, después de constituirse.
companies.source_version_note: Use 609.819M for 1998, as presented in the subsequent 1999 10-K/A. The original 1998 10-K reports 609.996M; do not silently mix historical source versions. Displaying 610M rounds both similarly, but this dataset uses the later filing consistently.

companies.name: Google
companies.origin_locator: Prospectus Summary / Corporate Information; also Management's Discussion and Analysis, Overview, printed page 50
companies.revenue_locator: Summary Consolidated Financial Data and Selected Consolidated Financial Data, Revenues row, years ended December 31, 2000, 2001 and 2002; values in thousands converted to millions
companies.model_context_es: Principalmente publicidad en buscadores. El S-1/A final reconoce los ingresos de AdSense brutos porque Google es el obligado principal; los pagos a socios aparecen como costos de adquisición de tráfico.
companies.accounting_locator: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements, Revenue Recognition, printed F-9; Cost of Revenues section
companies.source_version_note: Use the August 18, 2004 Amendment No. 9. The initial April 29 S-1 reported net revenues of 347.848M for 2002, while the final amended presentation reports revenues of 439.508M. Do not mix the initial net presentation with the final gross presentation.

valuation_chart_reference.verification_status: Original publication was not located in targeted web searches. Attribution is based only on the visible watermark, not verified provenance.
valuation_chart_reference.recommended_caption_es: Referencia compartida por el usuario. Marca visible: SemiAnalysis. Fecha y metodología originales no verificadas. La gráfica muestra valuaciones, no ingresos.
valuation_chart_reference.handling: Keep the supplied image as a separate visual reference. Do not infer exact datapoints or treat private-company valuations and public market capitalization as a standardized revenue comparison.
